hypothesis: Single-source German observation: an ImageGen clean photograph did not remove English in the encoded composite when the pasted label regions had zero alpha. Correcting the actual patch alpha and checking source/base/encoded-target samples removed the observed English/German overlap. The revised sample preserves people and call icons with minor reconstructed lace/hair and font-weight differences. A clean input image alone does not establish clean encoded output.
limitations: One source and one corrected German comparison, not independent cross-source validation.
